messages:
mia: quick sync — for the pricing refresh I want to run two small experiments on the calculator page: (A) tier label variants (Starter / Team / Scale vs Essentials / Pro / Enterprise) and (B) FAQ placement (inline 1-line microfaq vs expandable 3-item list). goal: reduce demo requests that are purely info-seeking and improve calculator conversion.
elliot: sounds good. suggest we also test CTA framing: \"Get estimate\" vs \"See pricing that fits\" vs \"Talk to sales\". keep the \"Talk to sales\" limited to high intent only.
marcos: routing proposal: tag leads with experiment_id and tier_variant. if lead.action == 'request_demo' && lead.calculator_score > 70 -> route to sales-immediate. else if request_demo && experiment_id == 'tier_B' -> route to webinar-invite for 48h, then sales. set fallback if sales backlog > 10 -> auto-nurture.
dana: can we avoid hard numbers public-facing? for benchmark line in the launch post use qualitative phrasing: \"Get a tailored estimate in seconds\" and link to the internal benchmark doc for press/partners.
mia: agreed. Matt from comms asked for a short webinar blurb + CTAs. webinar plan: 25 min walkthrough of the calculator + 10 min live Q. schedule two runs during launch week.
elliot: measurement plan: events = calculator_open, tier_select, cta_click, webinar_signup, demo_request, lead_routed. create cohort in GA and Looker with experiment_id tag. monitor support tickets referencing \"pricing\" as a lagging indicator.
marcos: pseudo-rule for webhook (shared for ops):
```
if (lead.intent == 'demo' && lead.calculator_score >= 70) {
  webhook.post('/sales/immediate', lead)
} else if (lead.intent == 'demo' && lead.experiment == 'tier_B') {
  webhook.post('/webinar/invite', lead)
} else {
  webhook.post('/marketing/nurture', lead)
}
```
dana: CMS notes: need snippet for both FAQ variants and three CTA copy versions. I'll prepare content blocks and upload to staging. also add hreflang for EU copy.
mia: ops-bot can you spin up a quick alert if webinar_signups < 10 after 6 hours of launch? want to pivot creative quickly.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: monitor.metric(\"webinar_signups\").window(6h).threshold(<10).notify(#marketing-ops).
elliot: timeline: flags on tomorrow 08:30 PT, monitor 72h, decide on day 4. ops: ensure webhook retry on 5xx and backpressure handling.
marcos: also add a tiny experiment to track whether inline microfaq reduces support threads. set a support-tag rule: if ticket contains \"pricing calculator\" -> label with experiment_id.
dana: I'll export copy drafts to this doc: https://docs.google.com/s/PRICING-PACKAGING-EXPTS (sharing open for edits).
mia: who owns the dashboard? @elliot?
elliot: I'll own daily checks and post a 1-line update in #marketing-ops at 09:00 PT each morning.
mia: perfect. keep the experiment lightweight — no product changes, just copy, placement, and routing flags.
ops-bot: Deploy started: feature-flag pricing_expt_tier_labels_faq -> staging (build 452). logs: https://ci.example/build/452
marcos: I'll validate webhook mapping and add fallback thresholds by EOD.
dana: final ask: please approve the CTA copy variants in the doc by 16:00 PT so CMS upload isn't blocked.
mia: thanks — let's ship small and learn fast.
